title: Are You More Mary or Martha?
subtitle: Five questions, two answers, one quiet truth
about: Two sisters, one dinner, and a very short, very pointed answer from Jesus about what actually matters most. This isn't about which sister is better. It's about which posture, sitting or serving, your particular week is missing.

verses.text: But the Lord answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art anxious and troubled about many things:  but one thing is needful: for Mary hath chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

questions.text: Friends are coming over in an hour. You...

options.text: Tidy the cushions, light a candle, and let the rest go.
Sweep, cook, set the table, and start panicking.

questions.text: When you read 'be still,' your honest reaction is...

options.text: Yes. That's the verse I needed.
Okay but who's going to do the dishes?

questions.text: After a long day with Jesus, you'd most want to...

options.text: Sit a while longer in the quiet.
Make Him dinner before He goes.

questions.text: If Jesus said your name twice today, the second word would be...

mary.name: Mary at His Feet
mary.description: You've learned the secret of the better part. You'd rather sit close than rush around, and that quiet habit is shaping the rest of your life more than you realize.

martha.name: Martha in the Kitchen
martha.description: Your love shows up as service, and any room you walk into is better for it. Jesus is calling your name twice. He's not asking you to stop serving, just to come sit with Him a while too.
